title: Four source-following decisions: overlap, leverage, coordination, and negative control
status: read-only qualitative audit; no claims of measured research acceleration

method.process: Search GitHub issues, open primary issue bodies and selected comments; follow explicit task and pull-request links (up to two hops); check selected publicly linked project data; compare against existing graph intervention reports.
method.live_source_access: GitHub connected account and public Hugging Face pages read on 2026-11-14; external GitHub texts not pinned to immutable commit revisions
method.graph_comparison: The existing graph reports were inspected, but a side-by-side timed automated graph query was NOT run. No unique graph advantage measured.
cautions: GitHub issue body timestamps and open/closed state are not experiment outcomes
Keyword search is a real baseline, not an exhaustive novelty review
An unobserved task metric is not proof of missing evaluation

verified_public_observations: #451 is open and describes a controlled 50B-token leave-one-out dataset ablation (English/other languages 80/20, three multilingual datasets). Updated 2026-11-14.
#448 is open and calls for evaluation of multilingual mixes, listing Arena-hard-2.0, elo-EU, math500, IFEVAL, AIME24/25 and GPQA-Diamond.
#186 reports earlier mixture and Dolci replay experiments, including English retention tradeoffs.
cases.interpretation: Related and complementary planned research, not proof of two independent competing implementations. Avoid proposing another ablation or separate IFEval implementation.
cases.smallest_next_action: Once #451 reports results, check whether its per-language evaluation and benchmark definitions are comparable to #448 and its previous #186 baseline; note any actual missing comparable metric, not just missing words in an issue.
cases.falsification_or_stop: If #451/#448 already share the evaluation contract, document no action. Do not infer a data-quality cause from leave-one-out scores alone.
cases.baseline_discovery: GitHub issue search for 'synthetic' 'instruction' returned #451 directly; 'IFEVAL' returned #448. Direct reading revealed their planned metrics and relationship.
cases.value: Potential avoided duplicate multi-run training; savings not measured.

verified_public_observations: #391 explicitly lists #432 as dependency for LlamaFactory-vs-TRL throughput and SFT/DPO comparison.
#432 comments link the active LlamaFactory branch and PR #65.

PR #65 is open, not merged; its description reports 332 unit tests passing and is focused on submission/configuration handling. Those tests are not a published same-configuration LUMI throughput comparison.
The project owner tire0011 has already asked on #391 whether blockers or benchmark assistance remain; no new generic contact is justified.
cases.interpretation: Known coordination and active upstream implementation, not previously undiscovered duplication; substantial review already under way.
cases.smallest_next_action: Monitor for #65 merge or public comparable SFT/DPO benchmark. Only then assess whether #391 has a genuine untested reproducibility or performance gap.
cases.falsification_or_stop: If maintainers post a same-budget throughput comparison covering #391, mark resolved/no outreach; do not repeat existing review comments.
cases.baseline_discovery: Search for 'LlamaFactory' returned both #391 and #432; first-hop #391→#432 plus the #432 comment→PR #65 is visible via ordinary source following.
cases.value: Avoid redundant review/outreach; no proven performance acceleration.

verified_public_observations: #437 defines the synthgen production pipeline with one judge and language-aware filtering.
#353 proposes sparse concept discovery and held-out verification for prompt-response datasets.
#416 is an open Propella-based instruction-level selection task, while #318 is closed; they are related curation work, not the same deliverable as PrefScope.
The public EuroMultiSynth-Instruct release has 4,160,598 accepted pairs and only judge scores 7–10 (77.7% are score 10). The released subset alone cannot reveal why rejected generations failed.
Published propella-annotations include several Dolci splits; available descriptions do not establish that EuroMultiSynth has the same row-level annotations.
cases.interpretation: Complementary methods and possible shared quality-control evidence; not duplicate projects and not a confirmed transferable artifact.
cases.smallest_next_action: Check whether already published Propella quality dimensions can serve as a *comparison methodology* on a tiny shared sample before integrating PrefScope; first compare language×domain×score and obtain independent held-out human verification. Do not assume existing Propella annotations align to EuroMultiSynth rows.
cases.falsification_or_stop: If no matching sample/independent labels are possible, or concepts add no actionable information beyond metadata, stop. No dataset quality or judge bias finding is established.
cases.baseline_discovery: Searching synthetic instruction issues returned #437 and #345; searching 'concept' 'dataset' returned #353, #318 and #32. A human must still inspect methods; search overlap alone does not establish a useful handoff.
cases.value: Possible avoided redundant annotation and clearer decision about judge vs generator; no demonstrated gain.

verified_public_observations: #392 remains open, with multiple extensive source comments documenting context-extension curriculum and high P(EOS) on RULER QA.
Comments document controlled checkpoint probes, a release discussion, and a newly published prelude-long checkpoint; the question is not untouched.
cases.interpretation: Avoid proposing generic EOS investigation, forced decoding, or basic long-context evaluation already reported. New claims would need to distinguish themselves from documented work.
cases.smallest_next_action: No unsolicited change. Revisit only when a specific, non-overlapping independent measurement or maintainer request becomes public.
cases.falsification_or_stop: Without a new decision gap, abstain.
cases.baseline_discovery: Following #392 comments directly exposes the active diagnosis; graph-only similarity is unnecessary.
cases.value: Correct abstention is a useful outcome; no quantified time saving.

next_evaluation.plan: Freeze 3-4 unseen seed tasks, hold same source window and review budget for a source-following human/text baseline and graph-assisted decision packet. Blind-check whether each answer changed a real research decision.
measure: independent actual saved effort or avoided rerun
next_evaluation.no_go: If none of the graph-assisted decisions exceeds the source-following baseline, do not build an automated idea engine or broad schema migration.
